metaDescription: What {brand} sells, what it doesn't, and how payment, delivery by {method}, refunds and the item guarantee work.

hero.title: A Counter-Strike 2 skin shop
hero.lead: Weapon finishes, knives and gloves for {game}, sold to customers across the {countries}. Each skin is bought from us outright at the price on the label, and arrives in your Steam account as a trade offer.

range.title: What we sell
range.body: Cosmetics only — weapon finishes, knives and gloves — arranged by weapon type and then by the weapon itself:

listing.title: What every listing shows
listing.single: A single item in a single condition, and therefore available to buy exactly once.
listing.exterior: Classification, condition and quality, together with the float range that condition permits on that finish.
listing.image: Steam's own standard render of the item.
listing.prices: A price you can view in {currencies}, confirmed again before you pay.

items.marketplace: Buy items from users or swap items with them. {brand} does not take items in.
items.cases: Sell cases, keys, stickers or agents.
items.accounts: Deal in Steam accounts, or ask you for a Steam password or a Steam Guard code.
items.other: Run gambling, case openings, or anything else settled by chance.

order.label: Payment
order.body: Pay by card ({cardMethods}) on our payment provider's secure page. Prices can be shown in {currencies}.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.body: Each item arrives as a {method}, {usual}. Steam may keep received items under trade protection for up to {days} days.

guarantee.label: Item guarantee
guarantee.body: If we cannot deliver an item within {hours} hours, or Steam reverses the trade, we refund it within {refundDays} days.

withdrawal.label: Cancelling
withdrawal.body: Cancelling is free right up to the point delivery starts. Once it has started at your own request, the {days}-day cancellation right is spent.
